title: capabilities
description: The agent's local capability state. Sent after the first heartbeat of every connection and after every change (for example after `set_capabilities`). The server stores it and forwards it to the panels; if an administrator asked to switch a capability off and the agent still reports it on, the server re-sends `set_capabilities`.

terminal_enabled.description: Remote commands (`execute`) allowed on this device.

vision_enabled.description: Screen preview, streaming and remote input allowed on this device.

server_ca.description: 0.1.10+. How the agent validates the server certificate: custom = the organisation CA installed with the agent, system = the OS trust store. Other values are ignored.
